statements.t: The Company expects customer activity to continue to be shaped primarily by operators’ longer-term capital discipline, basin-level economics and production priorities rather than short-term commodity price movements alone.

Although commodity prices have been impacted by recent disruptions in the Middle East, the Company believes customers will continue to prioritize efficient production from existing wells and disciplined development activity.

During the remainder of the year, the Company remains focused on continuing to realize the expected benefits of the acquisition, maintaining service quality for customers and preserving liquidity and balance sheet flexibility.
Our presentation of Adjusted EBITDA should not be construed as an indication that our results will be unaffected by the items excluded from Adjusted EBITDA.

We strive to maintain financial flexibility and proactively monitor potential capital sources to meet our investment and target liquidity requirements that permit us to manage the cyclicality associated with our business.
We currently expect to have sufficient funds to meet the Company’s short and long term liquidity requirements and comply with our covenants of our debt agreements.
There can be no assurance that we will pay a dividend in the future.

risks.t: market prices and demand for oil and natural gas

estimates.t: Our significant accounting policies are discussed in our Annual Report and have not materially changed since December 31, 2025.
